The candidate will work alongside the team to advance the goals of the Patterson Lab's research projects, including performing experiments, analyzing data, compiling results, writing manuscripts and contributing to grant writing, mentoring junior scientists, and supporting quality control processes to ensure integrity of research.
cond_0162.responsibilities:
Design and coordinate complex research procedures with the team.
Develop and perform routine and complex protocols for research programs in collaboration with lab staff.
Coordinate research study activities and help manage projects together with principal investigators.
Assist in developing, implementing, and monitoring quality activities.
Work with principal investigators to determine study design and perform statistical analyses.
Perform and develop routine and complex computational and database methods for implementation.

Develop new methodologies for lab procedures in coordination with colleagues.
Maintain supplies, may negotiate with vendors, and track purchase orders.

Mentor more junior laboratory personnel, supporting their training and development as well as helping coordinate daily work direction and prioritization.
cond_0162.requirements:
PhD in a scientific field
5 Years experience in cardiovascular science with rodent models
Knowledge of cardiovascular science, mouse and/or rat models, cell and molecular biology, data management and quality record keeping
Field of Biomedical Sciences
